modalLead: The window that asks what to do with a link you pasted, drawn as plain unstyled text.

items.text: The window that opens when you paste a link looks like a window again. Paste a link on the dashboard and Save this link appeared as bare text: the address printed on top of the question, and Add bookmark and Save to Inbox running together on one line with their 1 and 2 stranded underneath. Both choices now sit side by side as cards, and the address has its own line above them.
